verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an email/CRM SaaS like Brevo, but the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion endpoints, or erasure workflows. The closest items, contact-list import/update/organize and a 7-day transactional event export window, are adjacent features and not user-controlled retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
